messages:
Mira (Docs): Hey team — opening a docs PR that updates language around audit exports for private deployments. Need quick eyes on phrasing + an SDK snippet for the Node SDK. Link: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1234

Samir (Docs): Shared the PR, thanks. Main change is replacing 'audit logs are retained' -> 'audit records may be retained per customer retention policy'.

Priya (Legal): +1 on avoiding absolute language. Can we add a short example about legal holds? "Customer data subject to legal hold will be preserved beyond retention TTL" — is that too strong?

Mira (Docs): Good Q. Maybe: "Under legal hold, customers can request preservation of relevant exportable records; contact support for assistance." Keeps us from promising operational steps.

Jules (SDK): I'll add a Node snippet for exporting with pagination and TTL param. Draft:
```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const stream = await client.audit.export({ since: '2025-01-01', ttl: '30d' });
for await (const chunk of stream) { console.log(chunk); }
```

Samir (Docs): Nice. Can we include a curl example too? Short one-liner.

Jules (SDK): Yup: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" "https://api.redwood.ai/audit/export?since=2025-01-01&ttl=30d" > export.jsonl`

Ethan (Platform): FYI the private deploys don't support per-export TTL parameter yet; backend only respects tenant retention TTL. Should we add a note?

Mira (Docs): Oof—important. Instead of `ttl` param call it `suggestedRetention` and note "subject to tenant enforcement".

Priya (Legal): Add a line: "Retention requests are subject to tenant policy and applicable law." Also flag that legal hold process may require EO to validate scope.

Samir (Docs): I'll update the PR text. @Jules can you push the snippet change and update the curl command to mention "suggestedRetention"? Also fix the broken link to the SDK repo in the code box.

Jules (SDK): On it. I'll push a small patch and add a note in the PR description: "SDK endpoint currently accepts suggestedRetention; actual retention is enforced by tenant configuration." ETA 1hr.

compliance-bot: Reminder: please run the compliance linter on docs-pr-1234. https://ci.redwood.ai/linters/4567 :white_check_mark:

Mira (Docs): Thanks all. If Priya signs off on wording I'll merge after linter passes. If anyone sees edge-case language around "export" vs "snapshot", ping me.

Priya (Legal): LGTM with the updated phrasing. Marking as approved.

Samir (Docs): Merged after linter. :tada:
